```{r}
#| eval: false
jabotR::jabot_parse()
```

### Description

Read Darwin Core Archive (DwC-A) files from any downloaded dwca
folder at [JABOT](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/jabot) hosted by the
[Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden](https://www.gov.br/jbrj/pt-br).

### Details

Besides reading the files, the occurrence records are standardized so that
the herbaria can be compared and combined:

- 

-   
- 
-  
- `taxonRank`
- , 
- `family`
- , 
- `genus`
- ,

-   
- `specificEpithet`
-  and related taxonomic columns are cleaned. Family

-   names with a single equivalent in the current classification are

-   unified (e.g. Leguminosae to Fabaceae, Compositae to Asteraceae). The

-   specific epithet never repeats the genus: 
- `"Ormosia"`
-  as the epithet

-   of a record of genus Ormosia is removed (records of genus, family and

-   higher ranks have no epithet), and 
- `"ormosia monosperma"`
-  becomes

-   
- `"monosperma"`
- .

-   
- 
-  
- `country`
-  is always in English (e.g. 
- `"Brasil"`
-  and

-   
- `"Brazil"`
-  become 
- `"Brazil"`
- ), typos and non-countries are

-   removed, and 
- `countryCode`
-  is the ISO 3166 alpha-2 code of the

-   country. A missing country is taken from the records with the same state.

-   
- 
-  
- `stateProvince`
- : Brazilian states have their full official

-   spelling (typos such as 
- `"Pernanbuco"`
- , forms such as

-   
- `"Estado do Rio de Janeiro"`
-  or 
- `"Minas Gerais, MG"`
- , and

-   abbreviations are corrected). A municipality found in the state column is

-   moved to 
- `municipality`
- .

-   
- 
-  
- `typeStatus`
-  is standardized to English terms (Holotype,

-   Isotype, Paratype...) and values that are not a type are removed.

-   
- 
-  
- `eventDate`
-  and 
- `dateIdentified`
-  are in the ISO format

-   (
- `yyyy-mm-dd`
- , 
- `yyyy-mm`
-  or 
- `yyyy`
- ); 
- `year`
- ,

-   
- `month`
-  and 
- `day`
-  outside their range (e.g. 0) are 
- `NA`
- .

-   
- 
-  Elevation placeholders (e.g. 
- `-9999`
- ) and impossible values,

-   and coordinates 
- `0, 0`
- , are 
- `NA`
- . Collector numbers such as

-   
- `"s/n"`
- , 
- `"S/N"`
-  or 
- `"sn"`
-  are 
- `"s.n."`
- .

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| path | Pathway to the computer's directory, where the JABOT-downloaded dwca folders are. |
| herbarium | A vector of specific herbarium acronyms (collection code) in uppercase letters or leave it as `NULL` to parse specimen records for all herbarim dcwa folders in the defined path directory. |
| verbose | Logical, if `FALSE`, a message showing steps when summarizing specimen records will not be printed in the console in full. |

### Value

A list of dwca files, including data and associated metada.

### Examples

```r
jabot_download(herbarium = c("ALCB", "HUEFS", "K", "RB"),
               verbose = TRUE,
               dir = "jabot_download")

dwca <- jabot_parse(path = "jabot_download",
                    verbose = TRUE)
```
